chapter_title: Concerning the Three Blows that befell the Enemy because of the Light.
chapter_note: This short chapter is largely continuous cosmological-eschatological exposition structured as a threefold sequence of "blows" (three wars) culminating in final separation and binding. The only clear later layer is the dialogue/frame attribution at the start (paragraph 1). Otherwise the language stays cosmos→cosmos (Enemy/Darkness, Living Soul, fire, fetter, archetype, separation male/female, lump/tomb) without institutional or NT overlay.

paragraphs.core_text: The Darkness itself, the Enemy, has received three bad blows with three wars; and worse dangers from the Light in those three wars.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue/frame attribution: "Once again he turned, and says:" (late editorial/hagiographic framing).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Opening is a classic compilation frame marker (“Once again… says”), but the remaining sentence is impersonal, structural teaching introducing a numbered threefold cosmological schema (three blows/three wars).

paragraphs.core_text: The first: (The enemy) was brought out to the middle and separated from his dark earth, whence he had departed. He was vanquished in that first war, caught and [bound] by the Living Soul.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic first item of a numbered triad; purely cosmological mechanics (spatial relocation, separation from dark earth, binding by a named cosmic hypostasis). No audience-address or institutional application.

paragraphs.core_text: The second blow is the time when he will be dissolved and melted, and he perishes in this great fire. He is destroyed and overthrown, from the images that are all by which he exists. And he will be gathered in [to the] fetter corresponding to his archetype, and be made like he was from the first beginning.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Eschatological process-description remains internal to the mythic system (dissolution, great fire, reduction to archetype, return to first beginning). The correspondential term “archetype” and “fetter corresponding to…” reads like substrate-style cosmological mapping.

paragraphs.core_text: The third blow that will befall the enemy is the 'rolling back' [at the] end when everything will be separated, and male will be divided [from] female. Now, the male will be bound in the lump, but the female [will be thrown] in to the tomb. For it will be divided [ ... by a great] stone in their midst, for generation upon generation, for ever and ever.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the third item of the triad with final-separation cosmology (male/female division, lump/tomb, stone barrier) without pivoting to polemic, exhortation, or church practice.

paragraphs.core_text: ⟨p.106⟩ This is the way that the binding of the enemy will come about, in a fetter that is burdensome and strong, one from which there is never escape; because [they have achieved] his binding and bound him for ever. And they have achieved his being set apart, and he has been set apart for ever.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Summative closure of the cosmological mechanism (binding, fetter, irrevocable separation) still expressed as impersonal system-description; no Gospel citation, no institutional extension, no second-person exhortation.
